Schedule Your Eyebrow Tattoo Removal in Campbell

Regretting Your Microblading? Safe, Non-Laser Removal — No Scarring, No Pain.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Rated 4.9/5 Stars · 100+ Happy Clients · Licensed Esthetician · Women-Only Spa

Why Non-Laser? Safer & More Effective Than Laser for Eyebrows

At Aileen’s Beauty, we use an advanced patented tattoo removal formula that gently draws pigment out of the skin — no lasers, no pain, and no damage. This non-invasive treatment safely removes or lightens unwanted tattoos using micro-pigmentation techniques and premium ingredients with deep skin penetration.
The process begins immediately, forming a light scab that naturally lifts pigment from the skin within days. Most clients see visible fading after each session, with full removal achieved in two or more treatments spaced 4–6 weeks apart.
Our method promotes quick healing, minimal redness, and visible rejuvenation — leaving skin smooth, clear, and refreshed. Safe, hygienic, and expertly performed, Aileen’s Beauty delivers beautiful results with precision and care.

How Our Non-Laser Eyebrow Tattoo Removal Actually Works

We use a saline-based, non-laser formula developed specifically for cosmetic tattoo removal. Unlike laser treatments that target pigment with heat and light — which can cause hyperpigmentation, hypopigmentation, or unwanted reactions on delicate skin — our formula uses osmosis to draw pigment naturally upward to the skin surface. The body's healing response forms a light scab that lifts the ink as it falls away, leaving the treated area progressively clearer with each session. No heat, no burning, no chemical stripping — just a gentle, controlled process that works with your skin, not against it.

Eyebrow skin is uniquely thin and delicate — which is why laser removal near this area carries real risk. Heat scatter can damage hair follicles, alter skin pigmentation, or cause scarring that's difficult to reverse. Our non-laser method eliminates those risks entirely. Aileen has 10+ years of experience specializing in cosmetic tattoo correction and removal, which means she's handled the most challenging cases: severely faded microblading, over-saturated brow tattoos, previous removal attempts that didn't go as planned, and skin tones that respond poorly to laser. Every treatment is performed by Aileen herself — you're always in experienced hands.

Pigment Colors We Can Remove — Including Green, Blue, and Gray Eyebrow Tattoos

One of the most common questions we receive is: "Can you remove my green or blue eyebrow tattoo?" Yes — and this is actually an area where our method outperforms laser. Many cosmetic tattoos, especially older microblading and powder brow procedures, shift to green, blue, or grayish tones over time as the pigment oxidizes beneath the skin. Laser removal relies on targeting specific wavelengths of light within pigment molecules, which means certain colors — particularly greens and blues — are notoriously difficult or impossible to treat with standard lasers. Saline removal doesn't have this limitation. Our formula draws pigment to the surface regardless of color, making it effective against a much broader spectrum of ink tones.

Colors and pigment types we commonly treat include: dark black or near-black eyebrow tattoos, warm brown and taupe tones from traditional cosmetic tattooing, cool ash-brown microblading pigments, red-brown and orange-tinted brows from iron-oxide based inks, faded gray or silver brow tattoos, green-tinted brows caused by aging black pigment, blue or teal-toned cosmetic tattoos, and uneven or patchy results from previous fading or removal attempts. During your free consultation, Aileen will examine the pigment depth and color distribution and give you an honest assessment of what to expect from your specific case.

What to Expect: Your Eyebrow Tattoo Removal Timeline

Most clients require 2 to 4 sessions to achieve significant fading or full removal of their eyebrow tattoo. Sessions are spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart — this gives the skin enough time to heal completely between treatments and allows the maximum amount of pigment to surface with each session. Pushing sessions closer together doesn't speed up results; it risks over-treating the skin and can cause complications. We track your progress at every visit and adjust the treatment plan based on how your skin is responding. Some clients with lighter, more superficial pigment see dramatic results in just 2 sessions. Others with deeply saturated or layered pigment may need additional treatments. We're always honest about where you're at and what to realistically expect.

Here's what session-by-session progress typically looks like: After your first treatment, a light scab forms over the treated area and falls off naturally within 5 to 7 days, revealing lighter skin underneath. Most clients notice 20 to 40% fading after session one. By session two, 40 to 60% of the original pigment has usually faded. Sessions three and four target the remaining deeper or more saturated pigment. In between sessions, the skin continues to lighten as the immune system processes and eliminates the remnants of lifted ink. Full results are typically visible 4 to 6 weeks after your final treatment, once all healing is complete.
